watch.summary: While using Phoenix's ultimate in Valorant, the streamer returns to his spawn point only to find an enemy Jett waiting behind him.

beats.what: Streamer navigates the map while tracking enemy positions.
Streamer activates Phoenix's ultimate ability to safely push forward.
Streamer's ult ends and he snaps back to his body, revealing Jett right behind him.
Streamer panics and gets instantly shot dead.
Streamer laughs hysterically at the surprise trap.

watch.author: opponent
watch.key_line: Yo Jett Jett Jett Jett behind me!
watch.why: The instant realization of returning from an ultimate directly into an enemy ambush creates a great jumpscare beat. His sudden shift from tactical play to panicked screaming makes it punchy and funny.
